shortDescription: GE Profile™ 30" Black Built-In Electric Cooktop features a power boil on dual-ring element, precision temperature control, and guided cooking.

features.text: Cook faster with a variety of different pan sizes on this powerful rapid boil electric cooktop with a 3,100-watt flexible element.

Set your burner to an exact degree, not just high, medium or low, with Precision Temperature Control. Using a smart pan, the cooktop maintains a specific temperature – from 100 to 500 degrees. Perfect for sauces, candies and frying.

Connect a smart pan to your cooktop and your burners will adjust time and temperature based on a video-guided recipe in the app. Choose from thousands of recipes and get perfectly cooked food – from porkchops to pancakes. Pan sold separately.
Choose from 11 different heat settings with one easy swipe for total heat control.
A smooth glass surface and glide touch controls makes cleaning up messes simpler than ever on this easy clean electric cooktop.
Connect and control two cooktop burners as one to create a bigger cooking surface for pans such as griddles.
Synchronize your cooktop and GE Profile over-the-range microwave or hood so that your fan and lights automatically come on when a burner is activated with Chef Connect.
This smart cooktop features Built-In WiFi so you can monitor your burners and view power levels, precision temperature, or on/off.
Smart pans and a wireless sous vide probe easily pair with this smart cooktop to ensure you get the perfect cooking results. Accessories sold separately.
This electric cooktop's 7" element features a range of heat - from a dedicated "Keep Warm" setting to the power to boil water.
Protect against unintentionally turning your cooktop on with a safety control lock setting.
A quick glance is all it takes to know when elements are hot on the electric cooktop with hot surface indicator lights.
This cooktop will fit your existing 30" cut-out, or GE Appliances will help pay for modifications up to $100.
Bluetooth Pairing - Chef Connect with Hoods/OTRs and HestenCue Pans (HMI)
Precision cooking with HestanCue Pans (HMI and App)
